name: ecommerce
label: E-Commerce
description: Full-stack e-commerce operational schema: customers, products, orders, payments, shipments, returns, coupons, and reviews.
short_description: Complete retail e-commerce schema with variants, fulfillment, and loyalty.
long_description: Covers the full order-to-cash and post-sale lifecycle for a multi-tenant online store: customer accounts with loyalty tracking, product catalog with variants and SKUs, shopping cart with abandonment detection, order management with split shipments, payment gateway transactions, return/refund workflows, coupon engine, and verified product reviews.
when_to_use: Use when building a retail or marketplace application that needs a production-ready e-commerce data model with multi-tenant isolation.

table_notes.ec_customer: Registered shopper account with loyalty points, lifetime value, and acquisition tracking.
table_notes.ec_address: Reusable billing and shipping addresses linked to a customer; snapshots are copied to orders at checkout.
table_notes.ec_category: Self-referencing product taxonomy tree with SEO metadata and sort ordering.
table_notes.ec_product: Master product record with pricing, dimensions, SEO fields, and digital/physical flag.
table_notes.ec_product_variant: Purchasable SKU-level variant (color, size, etc.) with independent stock and pricing.
table_notes.ec_cart: Active or abandoned shopping session; may be anonymous (session_token) or authenticated (customer_id).
table_notes.ec_cart_item: Line item within a cart linking a variant to a quantity and snapshotted unit price.
table_notes.ec_order: Confirmed purchase with full financial summary, address snapshots, and lifecycle status.
table_notes.ec_order_item: Line item within an order with fulfillment tracking and return quantities.
table_notes.ec_payment_transaction: Individual gateway transaction (auth, capture, refund, void) attached to an order.
table_notes.ec_shipment: Physical package dispatched for an order with carrier, tracking, and delivery events.
table_notes.ec_shipment_item: Maps order items to a shipment with per-item quantity.
table_notes.ec_return_request: Customer-initiated return or exchange request with approval and refund workflow.
table_notes.ec_return_item: Individual item within a return request with condition assessment and restocking fee.
table_notes.ec_coupon: Discount code with percentage/fixed/free-shipping types, usage limits, and validity windows.
table_notes.ec_coupon_usage: Audit log of every coupon redemption tied to an order and customer.
table_notes.ec_review: Customer product review with star rating, verification, merchant response, and moderation status.
